desc: The Rugged Totem Multitool features six tools in one. Now you can have a tool that works with all Rugged's pistol, rifle, and rimfire cans without any additional wrenches or tools needed* plus a Rugged Suppressors tag. The tools are manufactured in-house by Rugged Suppressors to line up perfectly with your Rugged cans and accessories. Tools included: Obsidian45/Obsidian9 Front Cap Tool Recommendation is to tighten by hand and loosen with torque bar using the T-handle method. Obsidian45/Obsidian9 Retainer/Fixed Mount Tool The recommendation is to tighten and loosen with the torque bar. Supports full leverage and T-handle methods. Obsidian45/Obsidian9 3-Lug Retainer Tool The recommendation is to tighten and loosen with torque bar using the T-handle method. Oculus22/Mustang22 Front Cap Tool The recommendation is to tighten by hand and loosen with the torque bar using the T-handle method. Rugged Rifle Front Cap Tool The recommendation is to tighten by hand and loosen with the torque bar using the T-handle method. Rugged Rifle Flash Cap Tool The recommendation is to tighten by hand and loosen with the torque bar. Supports full leverage and T-handle methods.
